#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
mkdir -p out baseline-published data
exec > >(tee -a out/setup.log) 2>&1
# Select only layouts discovered by the probe. Persist selection for all runners.
selected=''
for root in /usr/local/cuda /usr/lib/cuda; do
    if [[ -f "$root/bin/nvcc" && -f "$root/include/cuda_runtime.h" && -f "$root/lib64/libcudart.so" ]]; then
        selected="$root"; break
    fi
done
if [[ -n "$selected" ]]; then
    compiler="$selected/bin/nvcc"; include="$selected/include"; library="$selected/lib64/libcudart.so"
elif [[ -f /usr/bin/nvcc && -f /usr/include/cuda_runtime.h && -f /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcudart.so ]]; then
    compiler=/usr/bin/nvcc; include=/usr/include; library=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcudart.so
else
    echo 'ERROR: no complete CUDA layout from probe' >&2; exit 1
fi
ls "$compiler" "$include/cuda_runtime.h" "$library"
printf 'export CUDACXX=%q\nexport CUDA_INCLUDE_DIR=%q\nexport CUDA_RUNTIME_LIBRARY=%q\n' "$compiler" "$include" "$library" > baseline-published/cuda.env
if [[ -n "$selected" ]]; then
    printf 'export CUDAToolkit_ROOT=%q\nexport PATH=%q/bin:$PATH\n' "$selected" "$selected" >> baseline-published/cuda.env
fi
source baseline-published/cuda.env
packages=(build-essential libopenmpi-dev openmpi-bin libfftw3-dev libfftw3-single3 python3-venv)
missing=()
for package in "${packages[@]}"; do
    if ! dpkg-query -W -f='${Status}' "$package" 2>/dev/null | grep -qx 'install ok installed'; then missing+=("$package"); fi
done
if ((${#missing[@]})); then
    sudo apt-get update
    for package in "${missing[@]}"; do
        policy=$(apt-cache policy "$package")
        printf '%s\n' "$policy"
        if ! printf '%s\n' "$policy" | grep -Eq 'Candidate: [^ (]'; then
            echo "ERROR: no apt candidate for $package" >&2; exit 1
        fi
        echo "Installing $package"
        sudo apt-get install -y "$package"
        dpkg-query -W "$package"
    done
fi
python3 - <<'PY'

Can increased parallelism in protein–protein docking improve the recovery of experimentally observed binding poses, particularly for AAV capsid–receptor interactions? We want to investigate whether additional parallel computation improves scientific results, rather than simply accelerating an existing search.

Use PINDER-S as the primary benchmark: https://github.com/pinder-org/pinder

It contains 250 protein–protein test complexes, including 93 with paired unbound structures. Prioritise those 93 cases for realistic docking evaluation. Use the published AAV–AAVR structures 6IHB, 6JCQ and 6JCS as a separate, biologically motivated challenge.

These represent AAV2–PKD2, AAV1–PKD2 and AAV5–PKD1 interactions. The AAV challenge should initially evaluate redocking from separated components. Do not treat these as independently determined unbound structures.

Investigate the following questions:
- Can existing docking methods recover known protein–protein interfaces from the benchmark inputs?
- What limits the number of independent candidate poses that can be evaluated or searched concurrently?
- Could restructuring the search exploit massively parallel GPU hardware rather than merely distributing independent runs?
- Does additional search improve the probability of recovering experimentally observed interfaces within a fixed time or compute budget?

Evaluate scientific correctness using DockQ, interface RMSD and native-contact recovery. DockQ ≥ 0.23 defines an acceptable-quality prediction under the standard benchmark convention. Compare the top-ranked predicted pose and the best pose among a fixed number of generated candidates. Do not conflate search coverage with ranking quality.

Compare wall-clock time, cost, search throughput and time to an acceptable pose against an optimised existing implementation.

Use independent random seeds and a fixed, preregistered selection of benchmark cases.

Begin with small calibration experiments to establish scientific validity, input sizes and actual performance.

Use those measurements to formulate a larger experimental proposal within a $1,000 compute budget.

Do not infer BBB transcytosis, binding affinity or therapeutic relevance from docking accuracy alone.

Explicitly report when the benchmarks or available structures cannot support a scientific conclusion.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p out
source baseline-published/cuda.env
ls "$CUDACXX" "$CUDA_INCLUDE_DIR/cuda_runtime.h" "$CUDA_RUNTIME_LIBRARY"
# CPU-only published method: no GPU context is created or used.
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, math, os, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path

mode=os.environ.get('EVAL_MODE','equivalence')
if mode not in {'equivalence','warmup','performance','curve'}: raise RuntimeError('Unsupported EVAL_MODE '+mode)
protocol=json.loads(Path(os.environ['EVAL_PROTOCOL']).read_text())
inputs=json.loads(os.environ['EVAL_INPUTS'])
seed_spec=json.loads(os.environ['EVAL_SEEDS'])
ids=inputs.get('ids')
if not isinstance(ids,list) or not ids or not all(isinstance(x,str) and x for x in ids) or len(set(ids))!=len(ids): raise RuntimeError('EVAL_INPUTS.ids must contain unique input identities')
kind=seed_spec.get('kind')
if kind=='deterministic': seeds=[None]
elif kind=='paired_median':
    seeds=seed_spec.get('seeds')
    if not isinstance(seeds,list) or not seeds or not all(isinstance(s,int) and not isinstance(s,bool) for s in seeds): raise RuntimeError('Invalid paired seeds')
else: raise RuntimeError('Unknown seed protocol')
scope=protocol.get('timing_scope')
if scope is None: raise RuntimeError('Seal lacks timing_scope')
raw_budget=os.environ.get('EVAL_COMPUTE_BUDGET','')
budget=json.loads(raw_budget) if raw_budget else None
if mode=='curve' and budget is None: raise RuntimeError('Curve requires compute budget')
if mode=='curve':
    if isinstance(budget,(int,float)):
        limit=budget
    elif isinstance(budget,dict):
        limit=next((budget[k] for k in ('gpu_seconds','gpu_s','max_gpu_seconds','budget_gpu_s') if k in budget),None)
    else: limit=None
    if not isinstance(limit,(int,float)) or isinstance(limit,bool) or not math.isfinite(limit) or limit<0: raise RuntimeError('Invalid GPU-seconds budget')
# FroDock has no published stochastic seed flag. Repeated seed identities execute
# fresh unchanged deterministic MPI searches; no invented random seed mechanism.
output=Path(os.environ['EVAL_OUT']); output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
for key in ('BASELINE_DIR','METHOD_DIR','BASELINE_OUT','METHOD_OUT','EVAL_OUT'):
    value=os.environ.get(key)
    if not value or not Path(value).is_absolute(): raise RuntimeError('Missing absolute '+key)
case_ids={c['id'] for c in json.load(open('data/cases.json'))}
records=[]; start=time.monotonic()
env=os.environ.copy(); env['EVAL_MODE']='anchors'
for seed_index,seed in enumerate(seeds):
    for input_index,input_id in enumerate(ids):
        log=output/f'run-{seed_index:04d}-{input_index:04d}.log'
        with log.open('w') as f:
            f.write(json.dumps({'input_id':input_id,'seed':seed,'seed_behavior':'published deterministic MPI protocol; no stochastic seed switch','gpu_count':0})+'\n'); f.flush()
            remaining=86400-(time.monotonic()-start)
            if remaining<=0: raise RuntimeError('Evaluation invocation exceeded wall budget')
            subprocess.run(['bash','harness/run_anchors.sh'],env=env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True,timeout=remaining)
        run=Path('out/latest').resolve()
        # Each call produces a new complete 93-case output; never reuse results.
        lines=(run/'scoring.log').read_text().splitlines()
        cases=[json.loads(x[len('CASE_METRICS '):]) for x in lines if x.startswith('CASE_METRICS ')]
        summaries=[json.loads(x[len('SUMMARY '):]) for x in lines if x.startswith('SUMMARY ')]
        if input_id in case_ids:
            found=[c for c in cases if c['input_id']==input_id]
            if len(found)!=1: raise RuntimeError('Missing input metric '+input_id)
            metrics={k:v for k,v in found[0].items() if k!='input_id'}
        else:
            # Non-case IDs identify sealed full-workload executions. Descriptive
            # keys of EVAL_INPUTS never generate additional executions.
            if len(summaries)!=1: raise RuntimeError('Missing full-workload metrics')
            metrics=summaries[0]
        if not metrics or not all(isinstance(v,(float,int)) and not isinstance(v,bool) and math.isfinite(v) for v in metrics.values()): raise RuntimeError('Invalid measured metrics')
        records.append({'input_id':input_id,'seed':seed,'metrics':metrics})
